scope: Manual text/audio/variation preparation, saved-result reconciliation and cancellation keyboard focus/feedback; partial Q06 evidence.

decision.Morgan: Stable exact focused nodes and App-owned request/outcome feedback, shared synchronous generation and cancellation guards, captured cancel request IDs and request-scoped acknowledgement/errors. Keep one feedback location: open manual tools beside its source action, otherwise root fallback. No completion focus or automatic audio-result scrolling. Keep cancelled/found terminal controls only until blur. An acknowledged still-running request offers a separate explicit retry.
decision.Steve: Independent proposal and challenge support stable controls. Reviews found uncaptured cancel targets, disappearing Retry, and old cancellation status/error affecting a newer request. Final actual source review supports corrections, no blocker; did not rerun build/lint/native checks.
decision.Elena: Independent proposal and challenge support stable controls. Review found root fallback reconcile scope and unconditional audio-completion scroll. Final actual source review supports corrections, no blocker; did not rerun build/lint/native checks.

phases.baseline: PR94 renderer:5 native projections reproduce BODY focus in text start/failure and cancel pending/terminal; failed text feedback is offscreen.
phases.initialReviewed: 2 native text pending/failure projections after initial guard corrections but before final request-scoping changes.
phases.reviewed: 15 failure/navigation +16 controlled-success +6 acknowledgement projections on final-bundles.json. This source has the final behavior except terminal cancellation label/duplicate-control polish.
phases.finalTerminal: 4 native projections on terminal-bundles.json recheck acknowledgement, focused Retry pending/repeated activation, one truthful terminal stopped control, and blur removal. Other reviewed cases are not claimed rerun on this last renderer.

checks.build: Final npm run build exit0 including TypeScript, session10491; terminal-build.log retained and hashed. Earlier TS optional narrowing failed and was fixed before native runs.
checks.lint: Final npm run lint exit0 session29391; terminal-lint.log retained and hashed. Earlier exhaustive-deps warning fixed before final native runs.
checks.predicates: All48 JSON projections parse; assertions pass for baseline BODY focus, focused native-enabled/unavailable controls, one error, no predispatch request, matching request reconciliation/readback, retained original IDs, real complete/interrupted manifests, no extra service execution on reconcile/reuse, player focus preserved after variation, final single stopped action and blur removal, zero external/HTTP attempts and identical paused playback.
checks.nativeOnlyWithoutProjection: First dispatched-stop success and subsequent Tab were observed in a single native AX call; only after-Tab raw snapshot retained. No separate terminal raw projection is claimed for that subcase.
checks.scrollObservation: Variation completion keeps actual Shuffle focus and its fixed player rectangle. Main scrollTop changes from2010.5 to1916.5 as layout changes (scrollHeight2730 to2716). A strict scroll-offset assertion failed and is not called a pass; source auto-scroll was removed, but no broader scroll-stability claim is made.
checks.reviewSavedTake: Existing Review saved take async action is not activated in this slice; pending focus and later-navigation ownership of that separate action remain unverified.
checks.draftProtection: Existing draft identity check and edited-script confirmation are unchanged/source-reviewed; no new edited-script replacement acceptance claim.

fixture.input: Native CUA input only at1280x720 and normal app zoom. Playwright evaluates read-only renderer/main telemetry and isolated fixture gates, with native screenshots/AX inspected inline.
fixture.baseRuntime: Production renderer/preload, copied instrumented actual main/storage, disposable safeStorage/catalog, null shared-key adapter, placeholder readiness keys, stopped automatic interval and muted media. No production main/shared source changes.
fixture.failurePhase: Pre-operation IPC holds/failures and actual NewsService pre-feed cancellable gate. Actual manual request persistence and cancellation execute; no upstream fetch or provider call. failure-phase-* files preserve fixture bytes.
fixture.successPhase: Copied service returns a fixed fixture script and bundled local demo MP3 bytes. Actual execute/publish/save/reconcile code and readback run against disposable files. fail-after transport executes the operation then returns an error to model saved-but-unconfirmed UI. This is controlled service output, not provider-generation quality or live provider success.
fixture.ackPhase: ack-only IPC mode returns without aborting the held request, simulating an unconfirmed acknowledgement. Explicit retry holds/fails or then executes actual cancelPreparedNews for that exact request. No paid provider call or charge/cancellation semantics established.
